finalText:
Build is clean now, exit 0.

The bulk of the noise (DEP0142/DEP0198/etc., tree-shaking notes, dedupe lines) was just chatter from the dependency bump — no action needed there. Two real bugs were hiding in the link stage, both caused by the new bundler's changed option shapes:

- `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the new field.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` the same as `false` (disabled).
